name: CrowdStrike Falcon
summary: CrowdStrike Falcon is a single-agent endpoint platform with machine-learning antivirus, endpoint detection and response and a central console. It publishes three self-serve bundles: Falcon Go at $59.99, Pro at $99.99 and Enterprise at $184.99 per device per year. Falcon Go is capped at 100 devices per purchase. Falcon Complete, the fully managed service, has no public price.

facts.text: Falcon Go is limited to 100 devices per purchase.
CrowdStrike offers a 15-day free trial with no credit card required.
CrowdStrike describes automated threat remediation and fleet-wide remediation from one Falcon sensor.
Microsoft notes that security vendors such as CrowdStrike use a kernel driver architecture, which it says gives visibility and tamper resistance at the cost of resilience.

plans.name: Falcon Complete

hiddenCosts: The page lists the same module names under Go, Pro and Enterprise, so confirm in writing which capabilities each bundle includes.
